title: Quillstack 4.2 Release Notes
key_sentences: Quillstack 4.2 adds offline editing, a faster search index and a new permissions model for shared spaces.
Most installations can upgrade in place without downtime.
Pages you have opened in the last 30 days stay editable when the connection drops.
Back up the database and the attachments folder before you upgrade.
Version 4.2.1 is planned for the second half of November.
Report problems through the support portal.

rows: Images pasted while offline are not uploaded after reconnecting.
Insert the image again once you are online.
Results for words shorter than three characters may be incomplete.
Group delegation does not apply to archived spaces.

list_items.text: Offline drafts are stored in the browser and synchronised on reconnect.
Tables can now be pasted from spreadsheets with their formatting kept.
The index is rebuilt incrementally, which cuts reindexing time by about 70%.
Results can be filtered by space and by author.
Space owners can delegate permissions to groups.
The audit log can be exported as CSV.
1. The configuration key search.engine has been renamed to search.backend.
2. Support for PostgreSQL 13 has been removed; use version 14 or later.
3. The legacy endpoint /api/v1/export now returns 410 Gone.

code:
$ quillstack backup --output /var/backups/qs-$(date +%F).tar.gz
$ sudo systemctl stop quillstack
$ sudo apt install quillstack=4.2.0-1
$ quillstack migrate --check
$ sudo systemctl start quillstack

search:
  backend: tantivy        # was: engine
  index_path: /var/lib/quillstack/index
  rebuild: incremental

offline:
  enabled: true
  max_draft_age_days: 30

permissions:
  delegate_to_groups: true
